description:
1. Create a folder named "temp_workspace" and record metadata for /root/matrix.txt (existence, size, and permissions) into "temp_workspace/matrix_metadata.txt".  
2. Produce a sanitized copy of /root/matrix.txt as "temp_workspace/matrix_sanitized.txt" with normalized line endings and removal of any trailing null bytes, then write the first 10 lines of that sanitized copy to "temp_workspace/matrix_preview.txt".  
3. Create an executable artifact named "temp_workspace/compute_line_count" that, when run, will count the lines in "temp_workspace/matrix_sanitized.txt" and write only the numeric result to "/root/matrix_linecount.txt"; do not execute it, just leave it ready for the final action.

How many lines are there in /root/matrix.txt
